zh.title: 子 Agent 实时活动滚动展示
items: Web 会话中的子 Agent 状态卡片会持续显示本机 Relay 同步的最新活动；长内容无缝滚动，短内容保持静止。
Android 会话状态条同步滚动展示最多三个子 Agent 的最新活动，切换任务后从头展示。
Web 在鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦时暂停滚动；Web 与 Android 都遵循系统的减少动态效果设置。

en.title: Scrolling live activity for subagents
items: Subagent status cards in Web conversations continuously show the latest activity synced by the local Relay; long updates scroll seamlessly while short updates remain still.
The Android conversation status bar now scrolls the latest activity from up to three subagents and restarts from the beginning when the task changes.
Web pauses scrolling on pointer hover or keyboard focus, and both Web and Android honor the system reduced-motion preference.
